objective:
TASK: new-business radar.

Find 10 home-service trade businesses (any trade: plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, landscaping, concrete, fence, garage doors, pest control, snow removal, carpet cleaning, well/pump, septic, chimney, appliance repair) in the geography above that appear to have opened or filed in the last 60-90 days. Look for: recent business filings, "grand opening" / "now open" / "just launched" announcements, brand-new websites or Facebook pages, chamber new-member announcements.
expected_output: numbered list of real, verifiable businesses (>=3 numbered items, >1200 chars). Raw capture is preserved regardless of validation outcome.
